rules.name: opens as a modal dialog and focuses the close button when asked to open
rules.source: Drawer.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with the phases of modal-phase.ts
rules.note: Opens with showModal(). Focus goes to the first [autofocus] element inside the dialog when there is one, otherwise to .drawer-close. It also sets the valueless attribute data-page-scrollbar on the dialog when the page shows a vertical scrollbar, and removes it when not.

rules.name: starts leaving on Escape instead of closing at once
rules.source: Drawer.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with the phases of modal-phase.ts
rules.note: Escape fires cancel on the dialog; the cancel is prevented, so the dialog stays open while the drawer slides back to its edge.

rules.name: closes once the closing animations have finished and returns focus
rules.source: Drawer.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with the phases of modal-phase.ts
rules.note: Waits for every animation on the dialog and the drawer to settle, then calls dialog.close(); the close event reports the dialog closed. Closing a dialog opened with showModal() returns focus to the element that had it before, natively. Under reduced motion no animation runs, so it closes at once.

rules.name: starts leaving when the close button is clicked
rules.source: Drawer.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with the phases of modal-phase.ts

rules.name: starts leaving when a press starts and ends on the backdrop
rules.source: Drawer.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with the phases of modal-phase.ts
rules.note: Both events must have the dialog element itself as their target, which is the backdrop area beside the drawer.

rules.name: stays open when a press starts inside the drawer and ends on the backdrop
rules.source: Drawer.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with the phases of modal-phase.ts

rules.name: stops leaving and stays open when asked to open again while leaving
rules.source: Drawer.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with the phases of modal-phase.ts
